notes.title: Ver.2.0 Update and price revision! Enjoy Co-Op play, new enemies and new levels!
notes.content:
Hello Lode Runners!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28999453/7660d92966a53bc5012709219b4665d921d1b4ee.jpg[/img]

Ver.2.0 Update is out now! In this major update, we have added Local Multiplayer Mode with up to 2 players, along with new levels. We have also added Extra Mode with new enemies and even more levels! 
 
Have fun with your friends and family in Local Multiplayer Mode! Using two controllers, you can play together with your buddy! Cooperation is the key to winning. By working together, you can capture the gold that is impossible to get alone!
 
In Extra Mode, you can play new levels featuring new enemies that have new movements that will destroy the blocks or self-destruct when falling in a hole. You can also utilize these new enemies in the Craft Mode!  
 
We also have improved the UI. Plus the prior Level Editor has been updated to our new Craft Mode where you can make your own original characters! Now you can replace your main character with your one and only original character! 


We are also pleased to announce that we are changing the standard price of Lode Runner Legacy. The new price is $11.99 in US dollars, E11.99 in Euro territories and 1200 yen in Japanese Yen. (Note: For some currencies, the original price may be unchanged or may be higher due to the exchange rate.) 

We hope you enjoy Lode Runner Legacy!
 
Team Tozai
